newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police catch naked priest in beach raid.
newsitem.headline: Italian police catch naked priest in beach raid.

text.p: Police caught a 60-year-old priest sunbathing naked on an Italian beach on Tuesday and charged him with indecency.
The priest was spotted during an air, land and sea raid by police squads seeking to stamp out illegal nudism at a Mediterranean resort on the Ligurian coast.
A police spokesman said three other nudists were picked up in the swoop.
Nudism is only allowed on certain designated beaches in Italy. The four people, who were not named, face a light fine.
